create_pipeline_demofusion_sdxl: create a DemoFusion SDXL pipeline for high-resolution text-to-image generation with tiled denoising
run_pipeline_demofusion_sdxl: run the DemoFusion SDXL pipeline to generate images from text prompts with multi-phase denoising
load_lora_weights_demofusion: load LoRA weights into the DemoFusion SDXL pipeline for text encoder and UNet customization
save_lora_weights_demofusion: save LoRA weights from the DemoFusion SDXL pipeline to a directory for later reuse
tiled_decode_latents: tiled decode latent representations into high-resolution images using overlapping VAE decoding patches
